messages:
alex: Heads-up — vendor pen-test report landed (s3://redwood-sec/pt/2026-03-15/report.pdf). They flagged three P1s: KMS key exposure path, missing audit exports for CrossAccountAssumeRole, and overly-broad reviewer RBAC role. Need intake + retest plan.

maya: thanks alex. can you drop the report summary here? quick TL;DR and which assets touched. we need to schedule remediation window and assessor revalidation. :calendar:

alex: TL;DR pasted from report: '1) KMS key policy allows kms:Decrypt from org account via old deploy role; 2) CloudTrail missing multi-region export for 90d retention; 3) admin-reviewer role includes iam:PassRole and ec2:ModifyInstance not scoped to service accounts.' Affected: kms key alias/redwood-prod-secrets, cross-account role arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/deploy, reviewer role in our org.

sam: assigning ops intake tasks. i'll create a tracking ticket and a short runbook for remediation steps. quick q: do we want to rotate the KMS key or patch the policy + require CMK usage via key policy only?

maya: prefer policy lockdown + evidence of deny for the external role in this retest window. rotation is heavier — if we rotate, we'll need new key grants for many services. for retest speed, patch policy and add explicit Deny for principal arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/deploy until they retest. also enable key rotation as follow-up.

lia: timeline note — we'll need a 2hr downtime window for some infra ACL updates if we rotate. if we only patch policy it should be no-downtime. ops: pls confirm rollback plan.

sam: rollback plan (short): revert KMS policy to current snapshot stored in s3://redwood-sec/backups/kms/20260315.json; re-enable cross-account if necessary via iam policy deploy job. i'll add steps to the ticket.

alex: for audit logs the assessor wants 90d immutable export + CloudTrail validation. can we enable multi-region CloudTrail export to a new S3 bucket with object lock?

maya: yes. steps: 1) create new s3 bucket with Object Lock enabled (compliance mode, 90d) 2) create new CloudTrail with multi-region=true, send to that bucket 3) confirm kms key used for the trail is a customer-managed key (CMK) with restricted policy. we'll keep current bucket read locked for evidence.

sam: i'll spin up the bucket and trail. sample terraform snippet for trail config i'll paste into ticket: ```hcl
resource "aws_cloudtrail" "pt_evidence" {
  name                          = "pt-evidence-2026-03"
  s3_bucket_name                = aws_s3_bucket.pt_evidence.bucket
  include_global_service_events = true
  is_multi_region_trail         = true
  enable_logging                = true
}
```

maya: thanks. also need to ensure the KMS key used for the trail has no cross-account principals. we'll attach a policy like: ```json
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[{
    "Effect":"Deny",
    "Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/deploy"},
    "Action":"kms:*",
    "Resource":"*"
  }]
}
```

alex: on RBAC — tester flagged 'reviewer' role. recommended fix: split reviewer -> reviewer-readonly and reviewer-admin; remove iam:PassRole from reviewer-admin except scoped to service-account roles. can we do a canary rollout?

maya: yes. plan: create reviewer-readonly (existing perms minus write), create reviewer-admin with least-privilege, do canary on 5% of users/org units for 24h, monitor alerting for failed workflows. rollback is simply reassigning group memberships.

sam: created ticket REDW-PT-4821 and added checklist: KMS-policy patch, CloudTrail multi-region + bucket lock, RBAC split + canary, evidence snapshot upload, and retest booking. link: https://internal.redwood/tickets/REDW-PT-4821

sec-bot: New issue created: REDW-PT-4821 — 'Mar/15 pen-test: KMS policy patch, audit export, RBAC split' (assignees: maya, sam). Automated reminder scheduled for 24h.

lia: retest scheduling: vendors asked for retest window week of Mar 22. maya/sam — what's our target completion?

maya: aim to finish remediation by Mar 20 EOD to give vendors time to retest. sam — can ops hit that?

sam: yes — plan ramps today and tomorrow. i will do KMS policy push tonight in a staged manner (dev->staging->prod) and CloudTrail bucket creation tomorrow morning.

alex: evidence expectations for retest: upload policy diffs, CloudTrail config screenshot, S3 object lock confirmation, and list of principals denied. put them in s3://redwood-sec/pt-evidence/REDW-PT-4821/ and send presigned URLs to vendor with 48h expiry.

maya: vendor access guidance: create an IAM role for assessor with only ReadOnly access to the evidence bucket and CloudTrail Describe permissions. use sts:AssumeRole with a time-limited session (1h). no console console root access.

sam: sample assume-role policy i'll add to ticket: ```json
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[{
    "Effect":"Allow",
    "Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::555666777:role/assessor"},
    "Action":"sts:AssumeRole",
    "Condition":{"NumericLessThanEquals":{"aws:EpochTime":1679000000}}
  }]
}
```

lia: once evidence uploaded i'll update the calendar invite and mark the retest slot. tagging sec-ops oncall for post-retest verification.

maya: blocker: need confirmation from product on any customer-impacting keys before we patch. alex — can you confirm product sign-off?

alex: pinged product in #product and got passive ack. they said patch policy is fine as long as we don't rotate keys. copying their note: 'ok to deny external deploy role for now, coordinate w/ci to restore if needed.'

sam: final Q: after we patch, do we want an automated smoke test to validate service access to secrets? i can add a short script in staging that runs 5 reads against secrets service and posts results to ticket.

maya: please do. add alert if any read fails; we'll stop rollout and investigate.

sec-bot: Reminder: auto-checkpoint scheduled in 24h for REDW-PT-4821 to confirm progress.

alex: thanks team — i'll start evidence collection and keep this thread updated with presigned URLs and screenshots. :thumbsup:

lia: noted. i'll prep the retest invite once sam uploads evidence.
